name: demo-repo-android
description: Gaia plugin config for the Android/Kotlin demo repo

codeRules: Use Kotlin Coroutines + Flow for async operations — no RxJava, no AsyncTask
UI layer must use Fragments with ViewBinding — no synthetic view access or findViewById
ViewModels must extend AndroidViewModel or ViewModel — no business logic in Fragment/Activity
Use StateFlow or LiveData for UI state — emit sealed class states (Loading, Success, Error)
Dependency injection via constructor — no static getInstance() singletons
Repository pattern required: ViewModels must only call UseCases, not repositories directly
All suspend functions in repositories must be wrapped in try/catch returning Result<T>
No hardcoded strings in Kotlin files — use res/values/strings.xml
No hardcoded dimensions or colors — use res/values/dimens.xml and res/values/colors.xml
testRules: Every new ViewModel must have JUnit tests in app/src/test/
Every new UseCase must have unit tests covering all branches
Use JUnit 4 or JUnit 5 — no third-party test runners
Use MockK for mocking — no manual fakes unless the class is trivial
Use kotlinx-coroutines-test for coroutine testing (runTest, TestDispatcher)
Tests must cover: loading state, success state, and error/exception state
UI tests (if required) go in app/src/androidTest/ using Espresso
forbidden: app/build.gradle.kts — do not add dependencies without explicit task
build.gradle.kts (root) — do not modify root build file
Do not introduce Hilt or Dagger unless the feature spec explicitly requires it
Do not use Java — all new files must be Kotlin
